module.role_assignments_for_policy creates role assignments for policy assignment managed identities using role_definition_ids passed in as plain string values (from archetype config), with no attribute reference to azurerm_role_definition.enterprise_scale. The sibling resource azurerm_role_assignment.enterprise_scale waits on time_sleep.after_azurerm_role_definition for the same reason (Azure RBAC replication delays), but this module does not. Role assignments may be attempted before the custom role definitions they reference exist/replicate, causing transient apply failures. Add a bare depends_on on time_sleep.after_azurerm_role_definition (no data-dependency fix is possible since the role definition IDs are computed strings, not resource attributes).
